## Tidepool — Build Plan

**Carried over from the library pattern:** left-rail week timeline, hand-drawn annotation arrow, monospace pull quote, one long-breath hero line. Palette shifts from forest to coast.

**Palette:** deep tide teal (#0F3D40), sand off-white (#FAF6EF), seafoam (#9ED8C8), coral accent (#FF6F5E).
**Type:** Fraunces (display), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (quote + annotations).

1. **Nav** — slim teal bar. Wordmark "Tidepool" with a wave-tick over the i. Links: Product, For Teams, Pricing. Coral pill button: "Start your week."

2. **Hero (two-column)** — Left: eyebrow "For small teams of 3–15," Fraunces headline: *"One shared view of the week, so Monday never surprises anyone and Friday feels like it was planned all along."* Pair of CTAs plus "Free up to five people" microcopy. Right: product screenshot.

3. **Week rail (persistent sidebar)** — Mon–Fri nodes running down the left page edge; today's node pulses seafoam; each node carries small avatar dots like tide pools.

4. **Annotation** — hand-drawn coral arrow curving from headline to screenshot. Mono margin note: "your whole team's week, one canvas."

5. **Social proof strip** — sand band: six small logos, one line: "2,400 teams who cancelled their status meeting."

6. **How it works** — three seafoam tiles: *Plan Monday together / Adjust in real time / Close the week out.* Each with a cropped UI vignette and teal line icon.

7. **Monospace pull quote** — full-width teal panel, oversized coral quotation mark: "We stopped guessing who was doing what. Tidepool made our week legible." — Priya N., eng lead.

8. **Feature proof** — split layout: screenshot left; right, three bullets (shared priorities, workload balance, Friday digest).

9. **Pricing** — three tiers on sand; middle card lifted, coral border.

10. **Final CTA** — teal block: "Make next week the calm one." Single email field.

11. **Footer** — sand, wave top divider, three link columns.

## Tidepool — Revised Build Plan

**Three upgrades:** hero restored to a single long-breath sentence matching the library's cadence; the week rail promoted from decoration to page structure (sections now map to days); pricing and proof get concrete names and a real stat.

**Palette:** tide teal (#0F3D40), sand (#FAF6EF), seafoam (#9ED8C8), coral (#FF6F5E).
**Type:** Fraunces display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for quotes, annotations, stats.

1. **Nav** — slim teal bar; wave-tick wordmark; coral pill: "Start your week."

2. **Hero (two-column)** — Fraunces, one unbroken sentence: *"Bring every person on your team around one living map of the week that updates the second plans change, remembers who promised what, and quietly takes the guesswork out of Monday morning so nobody walks into standup surprised again."* Right: screenshot.

3. **Week rail (persistent, structural)** — Mon–Fri nodes run the full page edge, scroll-spy linked. Each major section is stamped with a day (Mon / Wed / Fri) so the rail reads as a narrative spine, not garnish. Today's node pulses seafoam; nodes carry avatar-dot "tide pools."

4. **Annotation** — hand-drawn coral arrow from headline to screenshot; redraws itself on scroll into view. Mono margin note: "one canvas, zero 'quick syncs.'"

5. **Proof strip** — sand band; six wordmarks plus mono stat: "2,417 teams deleted their Monday status meeting."

6. **How it works** — three seafoam tiles keyed to rail nodes: *Plan together, Monday / Adjust in real time, Wednesday / Close it out, Friday.* Each tile highlights its rail node on hover.

7. **Monospace pull quote** — full-width teal panel, oversized coral quotation mark: "Tidepool made our week legible. I stopped asking 'who's on what?' in every 1:1." — Priya N., eng lead, 9-person startup.

8. **Feature proof** — split: screenshot left; right, bullets — shared priorities, workload-balance bar, Friday digest shown as an actual rendered email artifact.

9. **Pricing** — Drift (free, 5 people) / Current ($8/seat, lifted, coral border) / High Tide ($14/seat, SSO).

10. **Final CTA** — teal block: "Make next week the calm one." Email field, mono microcopy: "free up to five, no card."

11. **Footer** — sand, wave divider; a final tiny hand-drawn arrow points from the wordmark back to "Start your week."
